title: Enclosed parking garages.
officialText:
Mechanical ventilation systems for enclosed parking garages shall be permitted to operate
intermittently where the system is arranged to operate automatically upon detection of a concentration of carbon monoxide of 25 parts
per million (ppm) by approved automatic detection devices.
